criteria.statement: When assistant.agentic.enabled is true, HandlePromptRequest routes a valid prompt to AssistantAgentLoop.StartTurn and returns an agentic ContextVM result containing run_id, loop_state, and session status.
When assistant.agentic.enabled is false, the legacy single-shot planner and plan_hash approval path remain unchanged.
assistant/approval accepts action_id decisions without plan_hash and resumes deferred actions through AssistantAgentLoop.ResumeAfterActionDecision.
Startup recovery for persisted waiting_async agent-loop sessions calls AssistantAgentLoop.ResumeAfterAsyncObservation rather than stopping at AssistantToolRuntime.ResumeAsync.

internal/app/app.go wires the concrete OpenAI-compatible model client, MCP runtime/schema/registry adapters, permission engine, transcript store, tool runtime, and loop only behind assistant.agentic.enabled.
Repository compile passes with the integration wired, and no frontend item-9 behavior is introduced.
